destinations: arras.io (original WebSocket endpoint, with modified query params)

issues.description: The script overrides the global WebSocket constructor to inject custom query parameters into the WebSocket URL. This could potentially interfere with other scripts or site functionality if not carefully scoped.
issues.recommendation: Limit the override to only the intended WebSocket connections if possible, and document the behavior.

summary: The script does not perform any data exfiltration, privacy-invasive actions, or remote code execution. It only modifies the WebSocket URL used by the site to include additional query parameters. There is no evidence of obfuscation, XSS, or supply chain risk. The only minor concern is the global override of the WebSocket constructor, which is a low risk.
